visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame is split with a video inset at the top and a person sitting on a wooden floor in the background holding a black plush bear with a white muzzle. In the inset, a woman with dark hair in a sheer black top makes a series of cute facial expressions and hand gestures. The person holding the bear manipulates its arms to mimic the woman's movements. Red blush-mark graphics appear on the bear's cheeks during the gestures. (2) The scene transitions as the black bear is replaced by a blue bird plush toy with red eyes. The top inset video switches to a man in a black shirt who makes a shy, cute gesture by covering his face with his hands and smiling. The person holding the bird moves its blue wings upward to mirror the man's shyness. Blue squiggle 'shiver' graphics are added near the bird's head. (3) The blue bird is replaced by a white sheep or alpaca plush with small black eyes and a stitched smile. The inset video shows a man in a black tuxedo making finger hearts and placing his hands over his chest in a heart shape. The person manipulates the plush's small arms to match. Pink blush stickers and heart graphics appear over the plush's face. (4) The split-screen format ends and cuts to a full-screen shot of a man wearing a brown corduroy jacket over a dark shirt, sitting with his arms crossed in front of grey curtains. He has dark hair and looks directly at the camera with a neutral, slightly awkward expression. A pink text banner appears on his forehead. The video then applies a heavy blur effect with a large pink text box appearing in the center.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic male Korean voice narrates over a fast-tempo, synth-driven electronic pop background track. The voice exhibits a highly dynamic pitch contour, typical of an awards ceremony MC. Loud, wide-bandwidth crowd cheering and percussive hand clapping are layered prominently underneath the voice and music. (2) The energetic narration continues with a rhythmic delivery, coinciding with the transition to the second candidate. The background music maintains its steady 128 BPM electronic pulse. Crowd reactions remain at a high arousal level, featuring distinct bursts of female screams and general applause. (3) The MC's voice maintains its projected and excited tone, narrating the final candidate's cute actions. The electronic BGM provides a consistent energy floor. A collective wave of crowd laughter and intensified applause follows the vocal delivery, masking some of the musical high-end frequencies. (4) The audio undergoes a drastic hard cut. The high-energy music, narration, and crowd noise disappear instantly, replaced by a low-level, indoor ambient room tone. A single, brief burst of genuine female laughter is heard off-camera before the audio track ends in silence.
